question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

7, 17, ?, 137, 407, 1217
solution:
**The logic followed here is : First multiplied by (3) and then (4) is subtracted subsequently.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c78f72851395b64da62661f90041e0e5473388b4d2631448a27c3a6b0852ecf8.png] 

Hence, **"47"** is the correct answer.
